title: Dropdown
whenToUse: When there are more than a few options to choose from, you can wrap them in a `Dropdown`. By hovering or clicking on the trigger, a dropdown menu will appear, which allows you to choose an option and execute the relevant action.

Arrow pointing at the center
examples.description: By specifying `arrow` prop with `{ pointAtCenter: true }`, the arrow will point to the center of the target element.

examples.name: Trigger mode
examples.description: The default trigger mode is `hover`, you can change it to `click`.

examples.name: Click event
examples.description: An event will be triggered when you click menu items, in which you can make different operations according to item's key.

examples.name: Button with dropdown menu
examples.description: A button is on the left, and a related functional menu is on the right. You can set the icon property to modify the icon of right.

examples.name: Custom dropdown
examples.description: Customize the dropdown menu via `popupRender`. If you don't need the Menu content, use the Popover component directly.

examples.name: Cascading menu
The way of hiding menu.
examples.description: The default is to close the menu when you click on menu items, this feature can be turned off.

examples.name: Context Menu
examples.description: The default trigger mode is `hover`, you can change it to `contextMenu`. The pop-up menu position will follow the right-click position.

examples.name: Loading
examples.description: A loading indicator can be added to a button by setting the `loading` property.

examples.name: Selectable Menu
examples.description: Configure the `selectable` property in `menu` to enable selectable ability.

examples.name: Selection actions
examples.description: Use `Dropdown` with the browser Selection API to show custom actions after selecting text.

examples.name: Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of the Dropdown by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
